Simulation: an absorptive shunt notch (f0=1.80 GHz, depth≈−24 dB, Q≈9) reduces 200–800 ps energy by ≈12.4 dB while widening edge only to ≈80 ps. Standing plan: build PCB prototypes (lumped RLC and resistive quarter-wave stub) and bench-measure their real-world notch, insertion loss, and time-domain effect.
